subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security workflow owner approve these 14 upstream action revisions for the secret-bearing and repository-writing workflows on the refreshed exact head?
rationale: Full-SHA pinning prevents tag movement, but the patch still replaces executable third-party code that receives credentials or write permissions; repository policy and CODEOWNERS reserve that acceptance decision for the security owner.

options.title: Approve after exact-head checks
options.body: Refresh the branch and approve the grouped update once the affected security, token, Docker, release, and Codex-agent checks pass on that exact SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates if independent review or rollback boundaries are preferred.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until upstream behavior or a failing exact-head workflow can be investigated further.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and approve the grouped update once the affected security, token, Docker, release, and Codex-agent checks pass on that exact SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the central changed security workflows to this team.
